config.description: Buy ranks, perks, coins and crate keys for the WonderMC Minecraft server.

javaSteps: Launch game and click "Multiplayer" on menu
Click "Add Server" at the bottom right
Click Done, select the server and click "Join Server"
bedrockSteps: Launch Minecraft and click "Play" on the main screen
Select the "Servers" tab on the top menu
Scroll down to the bottom and click "Add Server"
Type the Server Name as: WonderMC
Click "Play" or "Save" to join the Server instantly!

rules.title: The Basics
rules.description: Respect the WONDER MC network, its community, and its staff at all times. Follow the rules of the server and cooperate with staff when required.

rules.title: Respect Others
rules.description: Treat every player with respect. Harassment, threats, discrimination, targeted toxicity, or intentionally creating a hostile environment is not allowed.

rules.title: Advertising
rules.description: Advertising other servers, communities, services, or invite links without permission is not allowed. Keep promotions within the channels specifically designated for them.
Use each channel for its intended purpose. Avoid unnecessary messages, spam, flooding, or content that does not belong in the respective channel.
rules.title: Channels

rules.description: Any hacked client, cheat, modification, exploit, or external tool that provides an unfair advantage is prohibited. Abusing bugs or unintended mechanics is also not allowed.
rules.title: Unfair Advantage
Teaming and Exploits
rules.description: Do not abuse glitches, exploits, or unintended game mechanics to gain an advantage. Any discovered exploit should be reported to the staff team instead of being abused.
Do not share, sell, trade, or give away your WONDER MC account or login information. You are responsible for all activity performed through your account.
rules.title: Account Security
No Spam
rules.description: Do not spam or flood the chat.
Do not excessively use caps or repeated messages.
rules.title: No Caps Abuse

rules.description: Do not harass, threaten, or target other players.
rules.title: No Harassment

rules.description: Do not share inappropriate or NSFW content.
rules.title: No NSFW Content

rules.description: Do not use discriminatory or hateful language.
rules.title: No Discrimination
Respectful Interactions
rules.description: Keep conversations appropriate and respectful at all times.

Punishments may vary depending on the severity and history of an offense. Repeated or serious violations may result in longer or permanent punishments. Staff members reserve the right to take appropriate action against behavior that negatively affects WONDER MC, even if a specific situation is not explicitly listed in these rules.
rules.title: Enforcement
